name: zcode-cohub
description: ZCode Chinese agent orchestration plugin CoHub — 12 specialized agent skills + delegate/council tools + Chinese language injection

scripts.build: bun run scripts/generate-skills.ts && bun run scripts/generate-agents.ts && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/src --target node --format esm && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build:hooks: bun build src/hooks/chinese-inject.ts src/hooks/job-board.ts src/hooks/orchestrate-remind.ts src/hooks/agent-tracker.ts --outdir dist/hooks --target node --format esm
